# Soham Enterprises – Official Company & Product Directory

Soham Enterprises (Est. 2014, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India) is a premier manufacturer, importer, and wholesale supplier of 100% pure therapeutic-grade essential oils, cold-pressed carrier oils, aroma chemicals, and natural botanical extracts.

## Corporate Identity & Headquarters
- **Company Name**: Soham Enterprises
- **Year Established**: 2014
- **Headquarters & Warehouse**: 2nd Floor, 20/24, Old Hanuman Lane, Near K M Chavan Tailor, Zaveri Bazaar, Kalbadevi, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400002, India
- **Primary Sales Contact**: +91 99309 96570
- **Customer Support**: +91 99302 82855
- **Official Email**: sohamessentialoilsofficial@gmail.com
- **Website**: https://sohamenterprises.vercel.app

## Core Product Categories & Catalog (80+ Items)
1. **Pure Essential Oils**: Lavender, Tea Tree, Peppermint, Rosemary, Lemongrass, Eucalyptus, Bergamot, Clove, Cinnamon, Basil, Frankincense, Ylang Ylang, Palmarosa, Thyme, Nutmeg, Vetiver, and 50+ other distilled botanical oils.
2. **Cold-Pressed Carrier Oils**: Golden Jojoba Oil, Moroccan Argan Oil, Sweet Almond Oil, Rosehip Seed Oil, Kalonji (Black Seed) Oil, Avocado Oil, Apricot Kernel Oil, Wheat Germ Oil, Neem Oil, Olive Oil, Grape Seed Oil.
3. **Aroma Chemicals & Specialty Extracts**: Anethol, Methyl Salicylate, Menthol Crystals, Thymol Crystals, Bhimseni Kapoor (Pure Camphor), Camphor Oil, Cajuput Oil, Nagarmotha Oil.

## Target Industries & Formulations
- **Cosmetics & Skincare**: Anti-aging serums, hair growth oils, creams, lotions, and facial balms.
- **Soap & Candle Crafting**: High-flash-point fragrance formulation for soy wax candles, melt-and-pour, and cold-process soap manufacturing.
- **Aromatherapy & Spa Wellness**: Ultrasonic diffusers, therapeutic massage blends, stress-relief synergies.
- **Ayurveda & Traditional Herbal Remedies**: Classical formulations, pain-relief balms, and antiseptic tinctures.

## Quality Assurance & Compliance Documentation
- Every batch is tested with Gas Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry (GC/MS).
- Batch-specific Certificates of Analysis (COA) and Technical Data Sheets (TDS) provided upon request.
- Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS) provided for commercial transportation and compliance.
- 100% pure, unadulterated, cruelty-free, and ethically sourced.

## Wholesale Supply, Quantities & Logistics
- **Sample Quantities**: 500ml, 1kg test batches for formulation trials.
- **Commercial Bulk**: 5kg carboys, 25kg HDPE cans, and 200kg industrial steel drums.
- **Mumbai Delivery**: Same-day pickup from Kalbadevi trade center or local courier delivery.
- **National Dispatch**: Pan-India door-to-door cargo and express courier logistics.
